name: Why people switch

sections.hero: Dek: what the reader leaves behind and what they get instead.
sections.items: Each item is one reason people move from the usual option to this one -- not a feature dump.
sections.audience_fit: Who should not switch, named honestly.

items.heading_hint: Use it when it suits you, not on someone else's schedule
More of what they want in one product
Setup and space, as the verified facts state them
Owning it versus paying per use -- careful with numbers

voice: Peer to peer, second person, short sentences.
compliance: Every number, price, spec or outcome needs a verified claim_id; a hint is never a fact.
No health or outcome promise for the product; a health statement cites the study and its population.
Never name or criticise a competitor brand.
A switcher's words are the ad speaker's own, attributed; never an invented customer.
writer_brief: Reasons people switch, written as reasons, not specs. Plain voice, verified claims only.
